notes.problem: At phase3 the solid cube and gripper execute route(unsafe) before phase4 changes the proposed trace. This contradicts the spoken pre-execution filter relationship: the physical action has already advanced along the candidate route.
notes.fix: Keep solid cargo and robot poised while a visibly identified candidate route develops and is projected toward the demonstrated corridor; execute the solid robot only after that change completes. Preserve the same poised state across s4–s5.

notes.problem: Phase6 ends the solid cube at GOAL [1.25,.61,.55], but phase7 starts it at [.76,.61,.78]. The same-subject cut claims continuous completion yet jumps the held object backward without a disclosed reset.
notes.fix: Begin phase7 from the actual phase6 endpoint and lower the cube vertically to tabletop support, then open the jaws and retract. Preserve the gripper and cargo identity through that cut.

code_observations.consequence: Phase7 lowers the cube to y=.215, opens jaws on p1 and retracts the empty tip on p2. That callable supported release is distinct from accident-prevention proof, but its initial cargo coordinates do not conserve the previous endpoint.
code_observations.disclosure: Every action scene renders scene.production_disclosure as a visible JSX child near the top; it states Illustration. Proposed research. Scene supers distinguish safe examples, intended filtering, feedback and physical experiments. No imported photo/video is used.
